<!--
Template shipped with the zfbehavior package (inst/skills/devtox-endpoints/).
Do not edit the analysis code below for a specific study -- put every
study-specific choice in devtox-endpoints.yml and render with:

  quarto render devtox-endpoints.qmd --execute-params devtox-endpoints.yml

This document only calls exported zfbehavior functions. See
inst/skills/CONVENTIONS.md for the run-folder / naming / manifest rules.
-->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(zfbehavior)

p <- params
skill <- "devtox-endpoints"

stop_param <- function(msg) {
  stop("devtox-endpoints parameter error: ", msg, call. = FALSE)
}
as_chr <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) character(0) else unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)
or_default <- function(x, default) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) default else x
pos_int <- function(x, what) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (length(x) != 1 || !is.finite(x) || x < 1 || x != round(x)) {
    stop_param(paste0("`", what, "` must be a positive integer."))
  }
  as.integer(x)
}

if (is.null(p$run_label) || !grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$", p$run_label)) {
  stop_param("`run_label` is required (letters, digits, '-', '_').")
}
upstream_runs <- sub("/+$", "", as_chr(p$upstream))
if (length(upstream_runs) == 0) {
  stop_param("`upstream` must list one dataset-import-qc run (plus optional QC runs).")
}
layout <- or_default(p$layout, "per_plate")
if (!layout %in% c("per_plate", "by_chemical_plates", "by_chemical_pooled")) {
  stop_param("`layout` must be per_plate, by_chemical_plates or by_chemical_pooled.")
}
chemical_col <- or_default(as_chr(p$chemical_col), "DTXSID")
if (length(chemical_col) != 1) stop_param("`chemical_col` must be one column name.")
title_cols <- as_chr(p$title_cols)
title_wrap_width <- as.numeric(or_default(p$title_wrap_width, 40))
if (length(title_wrap_width) != 1 || is.na(title_wrap_width) || title_wrap_width < 1) {
  stop_param("`title_wrap_width` must be a positive number (characters per title line).")
}
panel_order <- or_default(p$panel_order, "alphabetical")
if (!panel_order %in% c("alphabetical", "group_key")) {
  stop_param("`panel_order` must be alphabetical or group_key.")
}
n_row <- pos_int(or_default(p$nrow, 1), "nrow")
n_col <- pos_int(or_default(p$ncol, 5), "ncol")
pdf_width <- as.numeric(or_default(p$pdf_width, 15))
pdf_height <- as.numeric(or_default(p$pdf_height, 5))

project_root <- normalizePath(p$project_root, mustWork = TRUE)
out_dir <- "outputs"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
out_path <- function(object, ext) {
  file.path(out_dir, paste0(skill, "__", p$run_label, "__", object, ".", ext))
}
# CONVENTIONS.md section 2: every table saved to outputs/ is a tibble,
# including tables one level inside a saved list / result object.
save_rds <- function(x, path) {
  as_tbl <- function(v) if (is.data.frame(v) && !inherits(v, "tbl_df")) tibble::as_tibble(v) else v
  x <- as_tbl(x)
  if (is.list(x) && !is.data.frame(x)) {
    cls <- class(x)
    x[] <- lapply(x, as_tbl)
    class(x) <- cls
  }
  saveRDS(x, path)
}
# Outputs of a previous pass must not survive a failed re-render.
for (f in list.files(out_dir, pattern = paste0("^", skill, "__", p$run_label, "__"), full.names = TRUE)) {
  file.remove(f)
}
md5 <- function(f) unname(tools::md5sum(f))

has_reactable <- requireNamespace("reactable", quietly = TRUE)
show_table <- function(df, page_size = 15) {
  if (has_reactable) {
    reactable::reactable(df, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, sortable = TRUE,
                         defaultPageSize = page_size, striped = TRUE, compact = TRUE)
  } else {
    knitr::kable(df, row.names = FALSE)
  }
}
```

## Run

- Skill: `devtox-endpoints`
- Run label: **`r p$run_label`**
- Layout: **`r layout`**`r if (layout != "per_plate") paste0(" (chemical column: ", chemical_col, ")") else ""`
- zfbehavior version: `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("zfbehavior"))`
- Rendered: `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")`

## Upstream

Exactly one `complete` `dataset-import-qc` run (single-larva wells only:
`keep_well = FALSE` means the one larva was dead or malformed), plus optional
`complete` QC runs of that same import whose `excluded_plates` are dropped
(`CONVENTIONS.md`, section 6).

```{r}
#| label: upstream

read_manifest <- function(run) {
  dir <- file.path(project_root, run)
  f <- list.files(file.path(dir, "outputs"), pattern = "__manifest\\.yml$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(f) != 1) {
    stop("devtox-endpoints: no unique manifest found in ", file.path(dir, "outputs"), call. = FALSE)
  }
  m <- yaml::read_yaml(f)
  if (!identical(m$status, "complete")) {
    stop("devtox-endpoints: upstream run `", run, "` has status `", m$status,
         "`, not `complete`. Resolve it first (", m$status_reason, ").", call. = FALSE)
  }
  m$.run <- run
  m$.manifest_file <- f
  m
}
ups <- lapply(upstream_runs, read_manifest)
up_skills <- vapply(ups, function(m) as.character(m$skill), "")
if (sum(up_skills == "dataset-import-qc") != 1) {
  stop_param("`upstream` must list exactly one dataset-import-qc run.")
}
imp <- ups[[which(up_skills == "dataset-import-qc")]]
qc_runs <- ups[up_skills != "dataset-import-qc"]
if (!identical(imp$well_contract, "single_larva_wells_only")) {
  stop("devtox-endpoints: the import manifest does not declare `well_contract: ",
       "single_larva_wells_only` (older dataset-import-qc template?). ",
       "Re-run dataset-import-qc with the current skill.", call. = FALSE)
}
for (m in qc_runs) {
  qc_up <- vapply(m$upstream, function(u) sub("/+$", "", as.character(u$run)), "")
  if (!imp$.run %in% qc_up) {
    stop("devtox-endpoints: QC run `", m$.run, "` (", m$skill, ") was made on ",
         paste(qc_up, collapse = ", "), ", not on the import run `", imp$.run, "`.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}

imp_outputs <- data.frame(
  path = vapply(imp$outputs, `[[`, "", "path"),
  md5 = vapply(imp$outputs, `[[`, "", "md5"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
combined_rel <- imp_outputs$path[grepl("__combined\\.rds$", imp_outputs$path)]
if (length(combined_rel) != 1) {
  stop("devtox-endpoints: import manifest lists no combined.rds output.", call. = FALSE)
}
combined_file <- file.path(project_root, imp$.run, combined_rel)
md5_now <- md5(combined_file)
md5_drift <- !identical(md5_now, imp_outputs$md5[imp_outputs$path == combined_rel])
if (md5_drift) {
  warning("Upstream combined.rds md5 differs from its manifest: the import run was ",
          "modified after it completed. Confirm with the user before using these results.",
          call. = FALSE)
}

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  upstream = vapply(ups, `[[`, "", ".run"),
  skill = up_skills,
  status = vapply(ups, function(m) as.character(m$status), ""),
  excluded_plates = vapply(ups, function(m) length(m$excluded_plates), 1L),
  rendered_at = vapply(ups, function(m) as.character(m$rendered_at), "")
), caption = paste0("Upstream runs. combined.rds md5 matches its manifest: ", !md5_drift, "."))
```

```{r}
#| label: load

combined <- readRDS(combined_file)

# Plates excluded by QC runs (the import's own exclusions are already absent).
qc_excl <- do.call(rbind, c(
  list(data.frame(plate_id = character(0), reason = character(0), qc_run = character(0))),
  lapply(qc_runs, function(m) {
    if (length(m$excluded_plates) == 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      plate_id = vapply(m$excluded_plates, function(e) as.character(e$plate_id), ""),
      reason = vapply(m$excluded_plates, function(e) as.character(e$reason), ""),
      qc_run = m$.run, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
))
unknown_excl <- setdiff(qc_excl$plate_id, combined$plate_id)
if (length(unknown_excl) > 0) {
  stop("devtox-endpoints: QC-excluded plate(s) not in the import data: ",
       paste(unknown_excl, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
d <- combined[!combined$plate_id %in% qc_excl$plate_id, , drop = FALSE]

by_chem <- layout != "per_plate"
id_cols <- unique(c("plate_id", if (by_chem) chemical_col, title_cols))
missing_cols <- setdiff(c(devtox_input_cols(), id_cols), names(d))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("column(s) not in the upstream data: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}
na_cols <- id_cols[vapply(id_cols, function(cc) anyNA(d[[cc]]), TRUE)]
if (length(na_cols) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("column(s) with missing values cannot identify plates/chemicals: ",
                    paste(na_cols, collapse = ", "),
                    if (chemical_col %in% na_cols) " (choose another `chemical_col`, e.g. CHEMICAL_NAME)" else ""))
}
plate_info <- unique(as.data.frame(d)[, id_cols, drop = FALSE])
if (anyDuplicated(plate_info$plate_id)) {
  stop_param(paste0("column(s) not constant within a plate: ",
                    paste(id_cols[-1], collapse = ", "), "."))
}

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  plates_in_import = length(unique(combined$plate_id)),
  plates_excluded_by_qc = length(unique(qc_excl$plate_id)),
  plates_used = nrow(plate_info),
  wells_used = nrow(unique(d[, c("plate_id", "well_id")])),
  keep_well_false = nrow(unique(d[!d$keep_well, c("plate_id", "well_id")]))
), caption = "Data used (one row per well; keep_well = FALSE = one larva, dead or malformed).")
if (nrow(qc_excl) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(qc_excl, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Plates excluded by upstream QC runs.")
}
```

## Endpoints

`endpoints.rds` (always) has one row per plate x dose group;
`endpoints-pooled.rds` (pooled layout only) has one row per chemical x dose
group, with `N` and `n_affected` summed over the chemical's plates tested at
that concentration.

`calculate_devtox_endpoints()` counts, per plate and dose group (vehicle
control included), the larvae `N` (wells present) and the affected larvae
`n_affected` (`keep_well = FALSE`); `pct_affected = 100 * n_affected / N`.
`r if (layout == "by_chemical_pooled") paste0("For the pooled layout the same function is also run per ", chemical_col, ": wells of all plates of a chemical are counted together per concentration.") else ""`

```{r}
#| label: endpoints

endpoints <- calculate_devtox_endpoints(d, group_cols = id_cols)

pooled <- NULL
if (layout == "by_chemical_pooled") {
  chem_info <- unique(plate_info[, unique(c(chemical_col, title_cols)), drop = FALSE])
  if (anyDuplicated(chem_info[[chemical_col]])) {
    stop_param(paste0("`title_cols` must be constant within each ", chemical_col,
                      " for the pooled layout."))
  }
  pooled <- tryCatch(
    calculate_devtox_endpoints(d, group_cols = unique(c(chemical_col, title_cols))),
    zfbehavior_error_mixed_concentration_units = function(e) {
      stop_param(paste0("a chemical's plates use different concentration units, so they ",
                        "cannot be pooled: ", conditionMessage(e)))
    }
  )
}

has_unit <- "concentration_unit" %in% names(endpoints)
if (by_chem && has_unit) {
  u <- unique(endpoints[!endpoints$is_vehicle_control, c(chemical_col, "concentration_unit")])
  mixed_chem <- unique(u[[chemical_col]][duplicated(u[[chemical_col]])])
  if (length(mixed_chem) > 0) {
    stop_param(paste0("chemical(s) tested in different concentration units on different plates ",
                      "cannot share one concentration axis: ", paste(mixed_chem, collapse = ", "),
                      ". Use layout: per_plate."))
  }
}

treated <- endpoints[!endpoints$is_vehicle_control, , drop = FALSE]
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  plates = length(unique(endpoints$plate_id)),
  dose_groups = nrow(endpoints),
  treated_dose_groups = nrow(treated),
  N_min = min(endpoints$N),
  N_median = stats::median(endpoints$N),
  N_max = max(endpoints$N),
  dose_groups_any_affected = sum(endpoints$n_affected > 0),
  pooled_dose_groups = if (is.null(pooled)) NA_integer_ else nrow(pooled)
), caption = "Endpoint summary (per plate).")
```

```{r}
#| label: units

if (has_unit) {
  pu <- unique(treated[, c("plate_id", "concentration_unit")])
  knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(concentration_unit = pu$concentration_unit), responseName = "n_plates"),
               caption = "Concentration units of treated wells (plates per unit).")
} else {
  cat("No concentration_unit column: concentrations are shown without units.\n")
}
```

### Vehicle control: percent affected per plate

Affected vehicle-control larvae are background. They are not used in the
endpoint calculation of treated dose groups, but a high value questions the
plate.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-vc-affected

vc <- endpoints[endpoints$is_vehicle_control, , drop = FALSE]
vc_tbl <- data.frame(plate_id = vc$plate_id, N = vc$N, n_affected = vc$n_affected,
                     pct_affected = round(vc$pct_affected, 1), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
vc_tbl <- merge(plate_info, vc_tbl, by = "plate_id")
vc_tbl <- vc_tbl[order(-vc_tbl$pct_affected, vc_tbl$plate_id), , drop = FALSE]
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  plates = nrow(vc_tbl),
  median_pct = stats::median(vc_tbl$pct_affected),
  max_pct = max(vc_tbl$pct_affected),
  plates_any_affected = sum(vc_tbl$n_affected > 0)
), caption = "Percent affected among vehicle-control larvae.")
show_table(vc_tbl, page_size = 10)
```

### All dose groups

```{r}
#| label: tbl-endpoints

tbl <- as.data.frame(endpoints)
tbl$pct_affected <- round(tbl$pct_affected, 1)
show_table(tbl[, setdiff(names(tbl), "endpoint"), drop = FALSE])
```

## Dose-response plots

`plot_devtox_dose_response_pages()`: percent affected (0-100) per dose group,
vehicle control labeled `VC`, `r n_row` x `r n_col` panels per page, panels in
`r panel_order` order. No BMC results are shown; the `devtox-endpoints-bmc`
skill draws a new PDF with them.

```{r}
#| label: plots

plot_data <- switch(
  layout,
  per_plate = endpoints,
  by_chemical_plates = endpoints,
  by_chemical_pooled = pooled
)
key_col <- if (layout == "per_plate") "plate_id" else chemical_col
default_title <- key_col
tcols <- if (length(title_cols) > 0) title_cols else default_title
plot_data$plot_title <- do.call(paste, c(lapply(tcols, function(cc) as.character(plot_data[[cc]])), sep = " | "))
titles <- unique(as.data.frame(plot_data)[, c(key_col, "plot_title")])
if (anyDuplicated(titles[[key_col]])) {
  stop_param(paste0("`title_cols` must be constant within each panel (", key_col, ")."))
}
key_levels <- if (panel_order == "alphabetical") {
  titles[[key_col]][order(tolower(titles$plot_title), titles$plot_title, method = "radix")]
} else {
  sort(as.character(titles[[key_col]]))
}
plot_data$panel_key <- factor(as.character(plot_data[[key_col]]), levels = as.character(key_levels))

pages <- plot_devtox_dose_response_pages(
  plot_data,
  group_cols = "panel_key",
  line_col = if (layout == "by_chemical_plates") "plate_id" else NULL,
  title_col = "plot_title",
  title_wrap_width = title_wrap_width,
  nrow = n_row,
  ncol = n_col
)
pdf_file <- out_path("dose-response", "pdf")
grDevices::pdf(pdf_file, width = pdf_width, height = pdf_height)
for (pg in pages) {
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(pg)
}
invisible(grDevices::dev.off())

knitr::kable(data.frame(pdf = pdf_file, panels = length(key_levels), pages = length(pages)),
             caption = "Dose-response PDF written.")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-first-page
#| fig-cap: "First page of the dose-response PDF."
#| fig-width: !expr pdf_width
#| fig-height: !expr pdf_height

grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(pages[[1]])
```

## Status and outputs

```{r}
#| label: save

status <- "complete"
status_reason <- paste0(
  nrow(plate_info), " plate(s), ", nrow(endpoints), " dose group(s); ",
  length(key_levels), " panel(s) on ", length(pages), " page(s). Inspect the dose-response PDF."
)

save_rds(endpoints, out_path("endpoints", "rds"))
outputs <- c(out_path("endpoints", "rds"))
if (!is.null(pooled)) {
  save_rds(pooled, out_path("endpoints-pooled", "rds"))
  outputs <- c(outputs, out_path("endpoints-pooled", "rds"))
}
outputs <- c(outputs, pdf_file)

manifest <- list(
  skill = skill,
  run_label = p$run_label,
  status = status,
  status_reason = status_reason,
  rendered_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
  zfbehavior_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("zfbehavior")),
  upstream = lapply(ups, function(m) list(
    run = m$.run,
    skill = m$skill,
    manifest = file.path(m$.run, "outputs", basename(m$.manifest_file)),
    status = m$status
  )),
  inputs = list(list(
    path = file.path(imp$.run, combined_rel),
    md5 = md5_now,
    md5_matches_upstream_manifest = !md5_drift
  )),
  outputs = lapply(outputs, function(f) list(path = f, md5 = md5(f))),
  endpoint = list(
    name = "percent of affected",
    definition = "per dose group: N = wells (one larva each), n_affected = keep_well FALSE (dead or malformed)",
    group_cols = id_cols,
    pooled_group_cols = if (is.null(pooled)) NULL else unique(c(chemical_col, title_cols)),
    tables = c(
      list(endpoints = "one row per plate x dose group (always written)"),
      if (!is.null(pooled)) list(`endpoints-pooled` = paste0(
        "one row per ", chemical_col, " x dose group; N and n_affected summed over the ",
        "chemical's plates at each concentration"
      ))
    ),
    includes_vehicle_control_rows = TRUE
  ),
  plates_excluded_by_qc = lapply(seq_len(nrow(qc_excl)), function(i) as.list(qc_excl[i, ])),
  summary = list(
    n_plates = nrow(plate_info),
    n_dose_groups = nrow(endpoints),
    n_pooled_dose_groups = if (is.null(pooled)) NULL else nrow(pooled),
    n_panels = length(key_levels),
    n_pdf_pages = length(pages),
    vc_pct_affected_max = max(vc_tbl$pct_affected),
    concentration_units = if (has_unit) sort(unique(treated$concentration_unit)) else NULL
  ),
  parameters = p
)
yaml::write_yaml(manifest, out_path("manifest", "yml"))
```

**Status: `r status`.** `r status_reason`

```{r}
#| label: outputs

knitr::kable(data.frame(output = c(outputs, out_path("manifest", "yml"))),
             caption = "Files written by this run.")
```
